name: newleaf-api
description: NewLeaf shared API — market data, AI analysis, trade verification

scripts.build: tsc && rm -rf dist/shared && cp -r src/shared dist/shared && mkdir -p pipeline && cp ../pipeline/strategy-engine.js pipeline/strategy-engine.cjs && cp ../pipeline/gamma-analyzer-enhanced.js pipeline/gamma-analyzer-enhanced.cjs && rm -rf shared && mkdir -p shared && cp -r ../shared/reaction shared/reaction
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
